name: Search1API
description: Web search, news search, page crawling, sitemap discovery, and trending topics through one hosted MCP server.
notes: Uses Search1API's hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server. Every request, including tools/list, requires a credential: either the OAuth 2.1 browser sign-in (Dynamic Client Registration, no client ID or secret needed) or a Search1API API key sent as a bearer token. There is no anonymous mode.

auth.credentialHelp: Create an API key in the [Search1API dashboard](https://app.s1.dev). Sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

installHint: Sign in with the Search1API OAuth flow when prompted, or choose the API key option and paste a key from the Search1API dashboard. Tools: search, news, crawl, sitemap, and trending.
